title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Tier Sheet: Copay Assistance Coordination Terms
content:
Every Specialty Pharmacy Program tier names how manufacturer copay assistance is coordinated with the member's cost share. There are three coordination types:

- **standard coordination**;
- **variable copay**: the plan guarantees a reduced floor once assistance runs out;
- **maximizer**: assistance is drawn evenly across the year, and the enrolled member pays the maximizer member cost share.

## Coordination type and figures by tier

| Tier | Coordination of manufacturer assistance | Variable copay floor (per 30-day fill, once assistance is exhausted) | Maximizer member cost share per fill | Non-enrollee coinsurance (share of allowed amount, per fill) | Maximizer enrollment deadline (calendar days after activation) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | standard coordination | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0% | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | standard coordination | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0% | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | standard coordination | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0% | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | variable copay | $25.00 | $0.00 | 0% | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | variable copay | $25.00 | $0.00 | 0% | 0 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | maximizer | $0.00 | $0.00 | 30% | 30 |

How the figures apply:

- The **variable copay floor** is used only under variable copay. It is $0.00 where it is not used.
- The **non-enrollee coinsurance** is charged on each fill to a member who has not enrolled in the maximizer by the deadline. It is 0% where there is no maximizer.
- The **maximizer enrollment deadline** is the number of calendar days after activation within which a member must enroll in the maximizer before the non-enrollee coinsurance applies. The activation date is day zero. The deadline is 0 where there is no maximizer.

## Rounding

On every tier, every specialty member cost share and every assistance amount is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Illustrations (assumed figures only)

- On Northbridge Specialty Total Care, the activation date is day zero, so a 30-day deadline ends on day 30. For an activation on March 1 the deadline ends on March 31.
- On Northbridge Specialty Total Care, a member who did not enroll in the maximizer by the deadline and has a fill with an allowed amount of $3,333.47 is charged 30% of that allowed amount. That is $1,000.041, which rounds to the nearest cent as $1,000.04.
